subject: Operations
title: Root Cause Analysis
description: A fast breakdown of Root Cause Analysis for builders.

hook.text: A machine keeps breaking. You replace the belt. It breaks again. The real cause? Shaft misalignment.

buildup.text: Root cause analysis digs beneath symptoms to find the true origin of a problem, then eliminates it.

discovery.text: The 5 Whys technique asks why five times in a row. Each answer peels back a layer of the onion.

twist.text: Fixing symptoms feels productive but guarantees the problem returns. Only root causes stay dead.

climax.text: Toyota uses the 5 Whys daily. Workers are trained to ask why, not just to fix.

punchline.text: Ask why five times. Fix it once forever.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the 5 Whys?
